Administrative boundary polygon for a place

Source: R/bbox.R
cl_boundary.Rd

Geocodes place through Nominatim with polygon_geojson=1 and returns the matching boundary as an sf polygon. Used by cl_fetch_osm() and cl_bike_lanes() to clip a bounding-box query to the place itself, so that "Denver, Colorado" does not include Lakewood and Aurora.

Usage

cl_boundary(place)

Arguments

place

A place name, or an sf/sfc polygon which is returned as-is (unioned, in WGS84) so callers can supply their own boundary.

Value

An sf with one row: name (Nominatim's display name), osm_type, osm_id, and a POLYGON/MULTIPOLYGON geometry in EPSG:4326.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
den <- cl_boundary("Denver, Colorado")
plot(sf::st_geometry(den))
} # }
